drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, I own a Philly rowhome with a 7% mortgage and I have $50K in cash.

Over 10 years, which usually builds more wealth: paying the loan down, or using the cash to buy a second fixer-upper?

Show the math. Be honest.
drafts.pattern: Pay-off-vs-invest Grok ask (@notes_from_x, 15.6k in under an hour) + 'be honest' (@joelcomm, 8.0k). Hypothetical numbers, educational; let Grok answer, then quote-post the investor's correction.
drafts.video_tip: Screen-record typing the question, cut to Grok's answer, then a 30s selfie at a rowhome: 'Grok's math is close. Here's what it left out: repairs, vacancy, and buying at a discount.' Captions burned in.

drafts.draft_en:
Everyone's hunting Black Friday discounts today.

In real estate, I don't wait for a sale. I make the discount when I buy.

My rule on wholesale and flip deals: purchase plus repairs, all in, stays at or under 65% of ARV.

What's the best discount you ever bought?
drafts.pattern: Black Friday timing + Bar's own published 65% rule (worded as purchase plus repairs, all in, wholesale/flip only, per the Nov 14 SENTINEL lesson). Reply-bait question at the end.
drafts.video_tip: 15s: open on a 'SALE' sign or shopping bags, cut to you in front of a rough property: 'This is my Black Friday deal.' Overlay the rule text 'Purchase + repairs ≤ 65% of ARV'. Captions burned in; post today.

drafts.draft_en:
Every time the headlines say the housing market is in trouble, I get the same question: should I wait?

My answer: you don't need the market to go up if you bought right.

Buy with the discount built in, and a soft market is a window, not a threat.

Are you waiting or buying?
drafts.pattern: Answer to the fear framing (@macropaperr '🚨 US HOUSING MARKET IS IN TROUBLE', 9.5k) riding the new home sales wave (@KobeissiLetter 249k). No figures in the copy, nothing to verify.
drafts.video_tip: Hold up your phone showing a 'housing market in trouble' style headline (blur the account), then 20s talking to camera with the 'waiting or buying?' question as the closing overlay. End: 'Build your legacy on equity, not headlines.'
